NS applied to ViT attention on CIFAR-10/100 with measured accuracy gains (0.25–0.83 pp). Tests relevant regime but applies NS to attention outputs, not Muon optimizer update rule itself—not a Muon-family optimizer change.
Theoretical Riemannian gradient descent with one Newton-Schulz iteration. No empirical neural network tests.

AuON: orthogonal momentum alternative addressing Muon's cubic cost and attention logits instability. Directly relevant as Muon-family optimizer variant. Abstract doesn't detail CIFAR convnet testing or per-step cost measurement.

Proposes generalized Muon variants with arbitrary Newton-Schulz polynomial steps (including Polar Express quintic). Directly addresses NS coefficients and momentum settings. But abstract is incomplete; doesn't specify CIFAR-scale convnet testing or effect sizes in short training.
